results.content:
Democrats vote by mail more than Republicans.

In a new complaint last week, Democratic state attorneys general pointedly highlighted Trump’s own words on the issue, sent to his millions of followers on social media. [...] Eight states automatically send mail ballots to all active registered voters before Election Day: California, Colorado, Hawaii, Nevada, Oregon, Utah, Vermont and Washington. In 29 states, any voter can request and submit a mail ballot without providing a reason, and 13 others grant requests for mail ballots based on a voter’s reason for not being able to vote in person.

Those most likely to be affected by mail voting disruptions are older voters, people with disabilities
results.title: Democrats use mail voting more than Republicans. That’s why Trump is attacking it - Democracy Docket
